title: Sort List
statement:
Given the head of a linked list (as an array), return the list sorted in ascending order.

Can you sort the linked list in O(n log n) time and O(1) memory (i.e. constant space)? 
Use the merge sort algorithm on a linked list to satisfy this.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing list values.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers representing the sorted list.
